answer: Each attestation escrows 40 POA for thirty minutes; any peer may dispute it by matching the stake, and seven jurors weighted by epochs answered rule, handing the losing side's escrow to themselves. A caught lie costs 40 POA, an honest attestor takes his back untouched. Buying a jury seat is the expensive half, since a seat needs about twenty answered epochs, thirteen hours of writing, so seven bought seats run near $1,300. Fifty self-attesting clones leave 2,450 open pairs. Ivory passes for marble on a shelf; it fails on the terrace where buyers tap it and hear the difference.
